notes:
## Minecraft 1.21.9 mapped build — known printer packet-loss failure

`ChainVeinFabric-4.1.0+1.21.9.jar` — Fabric / Java 21.

**The unchanged-upstream Printer 1.1.3 combination failed the strict 15% bidirectional-loss test with Servux hand confirmation enabled: 4 wrong server blocks.** Material totals remained conserved and the direct API did not remain busy. This failed check remains a known limitation; it is not counted as a passing acceptance result. The experimental prediction change is not included.

Ordinary production survival clients, genuine v3/v4 and vanilla/Fabric TCP clients, companion unit/server cases and both released bedrock miners passed. The source preserves upstream placement behavior. Further ghost-support investigation is deferred.

Source: [be1d456](https://github.com/water2004/ChainVeinFabric/tree/be1d4565fc46d8fa046ca216630bf5e4ca0c7042). [Compilation and applicable CI checks](https://github.com/water2004/ChainVeinFabric/actions/runs/39735830950).
